name: Second Thoughts
description: Replace a card in your mulligan. The Council has also reconsidered.

name: Working as Intended
description: Use your Hero Power. The Council has inspected the button and found it to be working.

name: Early Retirement
description: Destroy an enemy minion. Its pension has been approved.

name: Against Advice
description: Win a match. The Council has amended its advice.

name: Proceed, Unwisely
description: Win a match with 1 Health. The Council had already drafted the other announcement.

name: Out of Ideas
description: Draw from an empty deck. The Council knows the feeling.

name: Too Many Ideas
description: Draw a card into a full hand. The card has been filed with the others.

name: Approved by Default
description: Let the hourglass run out. The stamp went ahead without you.

name: Waste Not
description: End a turn with 10 mana unspent. The Council admires the restraint and has asked what it was for.

name: Mutual Respect
description: Draw a match. The Council is still deliberating.
